name: @oramics/shell
description: Electron shell: window management, projector display, file save
author: Stuart Smith

scripts.build: pnpm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --publish never
scripts.build:unsigned: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false pnpm run stage && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --publish never
scripts.build:dir: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false pnpm run stage && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --dir --publish never
scripts.release: pnpm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --publish always
